transcript.text: This is Swift, an automated flood assistant working with local emergency services. Am I speaking with someone at 190 Sandy Hill Drive?

I hear you’re stuck with your dad in the wheelchair. If neighbors need a ride out, do you have a high-clearance truck, a boat, or free seats in a vehicle?
Nope, no truck, no boat, and we’re not got any seats to spare—just us two stuck here, dad in his wheelchair, can’t leave without help, and we’re not getting out on our own.
I hear you’re stuck and need help to leave. Let me read that back: 2 people; dad needs help leaving because of manual wheelchair; no water inside yet. Is that right?
Yeah, that’s right—two of us, my dad’s in a manual wheelchair and can’t leave alone, no water in the house yet, but we’re stuck and need help getting out.

I heard you, we’re here to help you get out. I've recorded that you need help leaving. No responder has been assigned yet. If water is rising inside, move to the highest floor and call 911 if you can get through. Goodbye.
